THE ANNUAL DISASTER (1921)

General Silvestre's traditional army is
annihilated by Abd el-Krim's forces.
12,000 Spanish soldiers slaughtered.
Melilla is on the verge of falling.
THE RESCUE

hysterical crowds. They stabilize the front
through sheer terror and brutal reprisals
(displaying severed heads on parapets).
The Takeaway: The Africanistas now genuinely believe they and they alone possess
the martial purity to rescue a degenerate Spain.

THE TACTICAL ZENITH: ALHUCEMAS (1925)
Card 1
The Operation
A massive, joint Spanish- French
amphibious landing to finally crush
Abd el-Krim.
Card 2
The Initiative
When landing crafts run aground in
deep water, Franco disobeys orders to
abort. He orders his bugler to sound
the attack, leading his men wading
through the surf under heavy fire.
Card 3
The Reward
The tactical gamble succeeds. By age
33, Franco is promoted to Brigadier
General--the youngest in Europe.

THE FALL OF THE MONARCHY (1931)
The Event: Following democratic elections,
King Alfonso XIII flees. The Second Republic
is declared.
Private Fury
Franco is enraged by the
usurpation of power, church
burnings, and the rise of the
left. He views the Republic as
a chaotic tool of Freemasonry
and Communism.
Public Calculation
Despite urging from hardliners
to stage a coup, Franco bites
his tongue. He swears loyalty
to the Republic, stating:
I am a soldier.
He waits, preserving his career
and rank until the perfect
moment to strike.
